stats_basis: quality statistics computed on the 3000 most recent bars, not the full 99999 bar archive
note_on_timestamps: Broker timestamps are server-local (MetaQuotes-Demo observed at UTC+3) but rendered here as UTC. Treat as server time, not true UTC, until the offset is confirmed and normalised.
validation_guidance: Fewer, broader segments; proportional holdout; reduced long-run robustness claims
execution_data_tier: TIER_2 — historical per-bar spread series available from the broker. Use measured spread rather than assumed distributions.
